# anthropic_federation_rule (Resource)

Manages a Workload Identity Federation (WIF) rule (`/v1/organizations/federation_rules`) that maps external OIDC JWT claims from a federation issuer (`fdis_...`) to a target Anthropic service account (`svac_...`). Requires an `org:admin` OAuth access token (`oauth_token`) or `federation` authentication. Deleting this resource archives the rule (`POST /v1/organizations/federation_rules/{id}/archive`).



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `issuer_id` (String) ID of the associated federation issuer (`fdis_...`). Immutable after creation.
- `match` (Attributes) Claim matching conditions that incoming verified JWTs must satisfy. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--match))
- `name` (String) Slug name of the federation rule (`^[a-z0-9-]+$`, 1-255 characters).
- `oauth_scope` (String) OAuth scope granted on minted tokens (`workspace:developer` or `workspace:inference`).
- `service_account_id` (String) Target service account ID (`svac_...`) that minted tokens will act as.

### Optional

- `applies_to_all_workspaces` (Boolean) Whether the federation rule applies to all current and future workspaces in the organization.
- `description` (String) Free-text description of the federation rule.
- `token_lifetime_seconds` (Number) Lifetime of minted OAuth tokens in seconds (`60` to `86400`, defaults to `3600`).
- `workspace_ids` (Set of String) Set of workspace IDs (`wrkspc_...`) where this federation rule is enabled. Required unless `applies_to_all_workspaces` is `true`.

### Read-Only

- `archived_at` (String) RFC 3339 timestamp when the federation rule was archived, or `null` if active.
- `created_at` (String) RFC 3339 timestamp when the federation rule was created.
- `id` (String) Unique tagged identifier of the federation rule (`fdrl_...`).
- `type` (String) Object type (`federation_rule`).
- `updated_at` (String) RFC 3339 timestamp when the federation rule was last updated.

<a id="nestedatt--match"></a>
### Nested Schema for `match`

Optional:

- `audience` (String) Exact match against the JWT `aud` claim.
- `claims` (Map of String) Exact-match `{claim: value}` pairs against top-level string claims.
- `condition` (String) Common Expression Language (CEL) expression evaluated over `claims` (up to 4096 characters).
- `subject_prefix` (String) Matches the JWT `sub` claim (exact match unless ending in `:*` or `/*` for prefix wildcard, e.g. `repo:example-org/example-repo:*`).
